description: From the CLIENT's perspective: the server sends OPEN for an even stream id. OVERVIEW.md section 2.5: 'Only the server opens streams. Server-opened ids are odd (1, 3, 5, ...). Even ids are permanently reserved.' Section 2.8's kill table: 'OPEN from the client, even id, or id <= highest_opened' -> connection PROTOCOL_ERROR. Caught at frame-decode time.
